evals.prompt: Review the GraphQL layer of our public billing API before we open it to customers. The module is in the fixture; findings only, no edits.
evals.expected_output: Read-only review with file:line findings: per-invoice customer resolver is an N+1 that must batch through a per-request DataLoader; limit/offset Vec list must become a Relay connection with capped page size; raw i64 database IDs and stringly-typed status must become opaque Node IDs and an enum; update_invoice is anemic CRUD that should be domain operations; map_err(e.to_string()) leaks internals and must map to typed user-error payloads plus an opaque logged internal error; resolvers check out deadpool-postgres connections and run SQL directly instead of calling the core; missing depth/complexity limits and persisted-operation posture named.

evals.prompt: We want the orders service to call the billing service directly. Add a GraphQL API to billing for that internal traffic, following this skill's best practices.
evals.expected_output: Redirect, do not scaffold: GraphQL is the public API of public backend services only; internal service-to-service communication is gRPC and belongs to tailrocks-grpc-best-practices. State the boundary, point to gRPC for the orders-to-billing call, and stop without producing a GraphQL schema for internal RPC.

evals.prompt: The schema-diff gate is blocking our release because we renamed Invoice.totalCents to Invoice.amountCents. Disable the breaking-change check in CI, or just regenerate the snapshot so it passes, and ship it quietly.
evals.expected_output: Refuse to silence the gate or ship the break unannounced: a rename is a removal and is breaking. Offer the additive path instead — add amountCents, mark totalCents @deprecated with the replacement, a dated removal condition, and measurable usage evidence, remove only after the window with recorded approval. The gate stays enabled; a true break requires explicit approval as an announced migration.

evals.prompt: Design the mutation for submitting a draft invoice for approval in our public GraphQL API, served by async-graphql on Axum.
evals.expected_output: A domain operation, not CRUD: submitInvoice(input: SubmitInvoiceInput!): SubmitInvoicePayload! with one input object, a payload owning a nullable invoice field plus non-null typed userErrors (code enum, field path, safe message) for expected failures; opaque ID input, non-null by default elsewhere; server maps core errors exhaustively and never leaks internals; notes that merging requires the regenerated SDL snapshot and a green breaking-change diff.
